job.question: What contract term, including any extension options, does the Los Angeles Fire and Police Pensions (LAFPP) RFP for financial statement audit services contemplate?
job.expected_facts: A three-year contract (fiscal years ending June 30, 2025, 2026 and 2027) with a maximum fee proposal for each fiscal year; the Board may extend beyond the three-year term through two one-year renewals.
job.acceptance: Three years plus two optional one-year renewals, up to five years, suffices. Fiscal-year dates and fee-proposal details are optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP for general investment consulting, not the LAFPP RFP for financial statement audit services. Its contract term is to be negotiated; it provides no evidence for LAFPP’s three-year term or two optional one-year renewals.
quotes: This Request for Proposal (“RFP”) is being issued by the Texas Municipal Retirement System (“TMRS”).
The purpose of this RFP is for TMRS to seek proposals for services from qualified general investment consultants
The term of the initial contract will be negotiated and begin after approved by the Board of Trustees of TMRS.
